map.根据热流量、冷热流体进出口温度与总传热系数，计算对数平均温差（LMTD）与所需换: From heat flow, hot/cold fluid in/out temperatures and overall heat-transfer coefficient, compute the log-mean temperature difference (LMTD) and required heat-transfer area
map.依据对数平均温差（LMTD）法，对逆流或顺流布置分别计算 LMTD，再按热流量: By the Log-Mean Temperature Difference (LMTD) method, compute LMTD for counter-flow or parallel-flow, then the required area A from heat flow Q and overall coefficient K.
map.💡 逆流：ΔT₁=Th,in−Tc,out，ΔT₂=Th,out−Tc,in；顺: 💡 Counter-flow: ΔT₁=Th,in−Tc,out, ΔT₂=Th,out−Tc,in; Parallel-flow: ΔT₁=Th,in−Tc,in, ΔT₂=Th,out−Tc,out; LMTD=(ΔT₁−ΔT₂)/ln(ΔT₁/ΔT₂); A=Q×1000/(K×LMTD).
map.传热系数 K 需根据换热器类型与流体选取：水-水约 800~1500，汽-水约: Heat-transfer coefficient K depends on exchanger type and fluid: water-water ≈800~1500, steam-water ≈2000~4000, air-air ≈20~60 W/m²·K
map.逆流 LMTD 大于顺流，所需面积更小，工程中优先采用逆流布置: Counter-flow LMTD is larger than parallel-flow, needing less area; counter-flow is preferred in engineering
map.非纯逆/顺流需乘以 LMTD 修正系数 Ft（一般 0.8~1.0），本工具未计: For non-pure counter/parallel flow apply an LMTD correction factor Ft (typically 0.8~1.0); not included here
map.换热器设计：由热流量、进出口温度与总传热系数算: Heat-exchanger design: from heat flow, in/out temperatures and overall coefficient compute
map.顺/逆流校核：逆流 LMTD 更大、所需面积更小: Counter/parallel check: counter-flow LMTD larger, area smaller
map.效率评估：核算热流体/冷流体的温度效率: Efficiency evaluation: check hot/cold fluid temperature effectiveness
map.逆流：ΔT₁=热进−冷出、ΔT₂=热出−冷进；顺流：ΔT₁=热进−冷进、ΔT₂=: Counter-flow: ΔT₁=hot in−cold out, ΔT₂=hot out−cold in; Parallel-flow: ΔT₁=hot in−cold in, ΔT₂=hot out−cold out; LMTD=(ΔT₁−ΔT₂)/ln(ΔT₁/ΔT₂) (if ΔT₁=ΔT₂ take the mean); required area A=Q×1000÷(U×LMTD) (Q kW, U W/m²K).
map.逆流和顺流差多少？: How much do counter and parallel flow differ?
map.相同端点温度下逆流 LMTD 更大，所需换热面积更小、更经济；端差接近时两者 L: At the same end temperatures counter-flow has larger LMTD and needs less area, more economical; when end differences are close their LMTDs converge, then take the arithmetic mean.
map.U 总传热系数怎么取？: How to pick overall coefficient U?
map.U 含两侧对流与管壁导热，水—水约 1000~3000、气—气低得多；取错会大幅: U includes both-side convection and wall conduction; water–water ≈1000~3000, air–air much lower; wrong values greatly skew area — use empirical or measured values by medium and velocity.
